LESSON: KUSOMA 8 .2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA TAMTHILIA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: UHALIFU WA MTANDAONI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za U
Topic 8.2: Kusoma 8 .2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 8 .2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia
2. kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ili kuubanisha
3. kujadili mandhari na ploti ya tamthilia aliyosoma

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ili kuubanisha
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ili kuubanisha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kujadili mandhari na ploti ya tamthilia aliyosoma
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili mandhari na ploti ya tamthilia aliyosoma. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 8 .2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 8 .2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 8 .2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 8 .2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia.
4. Show that you can: kutambua mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 8 .2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 8 .2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua mandhari na ploti katika tamthilia
2. kueleza umuhimu wa mandhari na ploti ili kuubanisha
3. kujadili mandhari na ploti ya tamthilia aliyosoma

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
